title: Trust
description: Thinking about the robot doing THIS task with what you just taught it, rate how much you agree with each statement.

metadata.instrument: Trust in Automation (TiA) — 'Trust in Automation' subscale (items 9 & 14), ADAPTED
metadata.citation: Körber, M. (2019). Theoretical considerations and development of a questionnaire to measure trust in automation. In Proceedings of the 20th Congress of the International Ergonomics Association (IEA 2018), 13-30.
metadata.adaptation: Item stems are anchored to the taught task ('…to do this task successfully' / '…to do this task correctly') instead of the generic 'the robot'. Bare TiA wording was ambiguous here: a participant who had only set reward sliders could not tell what 'I trust the robot' referred to. Report as adapted from Körber (2019).
metadata.scoring: Average the two items for a Trust score. Neither item is reverse-coded.

items.prompt: I trust this robot to do this task successfully.
I can rely on this robot to do this task correctly, without me stepping in.
